_comment: PRD E7.1 — golden text-to-SQL set. Each item: a question, the canonical T-SQL (must pass tools._safe_select), and the expected result over sample-estate/ as of 2026-09-08. The runner executes the SQL against a SQLite copy of the sample (evals/sample_db.py) and checks an exact match. The 'model generates SQL that matches' gate needs a live model and runs in CI with credentials.

cases.q: How many servers are in scope?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM servers

cases.q: How many servers are powered on?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM servers WHERE powerstate = 'poweredOn'

cases.q: What is the total vCPU across all servers?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(vcpu) FROM servers

cases.q: What is the total RAM in GB?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(ram_gb) FROM servers

cases.q: How many production servers are there?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM servers WHERE env = 'prod'

cases.q: Break down server count by environment.
cases.sql: SELECT env, COUNT(*) FROM servers GROUP BY env ORDER BY env

cases.q: How many Windows servers?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM servers WHERE os_name LIKE '%Windows%'

cases.q: How many Linux servers?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM servers WHERE os_name NOT LIKE '%Windows%'

cases.q: How many servers are past OS end-of-support?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM servers WHERE os_eol_date IS NOT NULL AND os_eol_date < CAST(SYSUTCDATETIME() AS DATE)

cases.q: How many servers have no p95 CPU reading?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM servers WHERE cpu_p95_pct IS NULL

cases.q: How many applications are there?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications

cases.q: Break down applications by criticality.
cases.sql: SELECT criticality, COUNT(*) FROM applications GROUP BY criticality ORDER BY criticality

cases.q: How many internet-facing applications?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications WHERE internet_facing = 1

cases.q: How many applications are in PCI-DSS scope?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications WHERE compliance_scope LIKE '%PCI%'

cases.q: How many distinct compliance scopes appear in the portfolio?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT compliance_scope) FROM applications WHERE compliance_scope IS NOT NULL AND compliance_scope <> ''

cases.q: What is the total provisioned disk in GB?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(provisioned_disk_gb) FROM servers

cases.q: What is the total used disk in GB?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(used_disk_gb) FROM servers

cases.q: Break down storage volumes by type.
cases.sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) FROM storage GROUP BY type ORDER BY type

cases.q: What is the total file-share storage in GB?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(size_gb) FROM storage WHERE type = 'file'

cases.q: What is the total database-volume storage in GB?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(size_gb) FROM storage WHERE type = 'db'

cases.q: How many dependency rows are there?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dependencies

cases.q: Break down dependency rows by confidence.
cases.sql: SELECT confidence, COUNT(*) FROM dependencies GROUP BY confidence ORDER BY confidence

cases.q: How many high-confidence dependencies?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dependencies WHERE confidence = 'high'

cases.q: Total observed outbound data over 30 days, in GB.
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(bytes_30d_gb) FROM dependencies WHERE direction = 'outbound'

cases.q: How many performance sample rows are there?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance

cases.q: How many distinct servers have performance samples?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT server_id) FROM performance

cases.q: What is the average p95 CPU for production servers?
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(cpu_p95_pct), 1) FROM servers WHERE env = 'prod' AND cpu_p95_pct IS NOT NULL

cases.q: Which 3 applications have the most users?
cases.sql: SELECT TOP 3 app_name, users FROM applications WHERE users IS NOT NULL ORDER BY users DESC

cases.q: How many servers are not mapped to an application?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM servers WHERE app_id IS NULL OR app_id = ''

cases.q: Break down databases by engine.
cases.sql: SELECT db_engine, COUNT(*) FROM applications WHERE db_engine IS NOT NULL AND db_engine <> '' GROUP BY db_engine ORDER BY db_engine

cases.q: What is the single largest server by vCPU?
cases.sql: SELECT TOP 1 hostname, vcpu FROM servers ORDER BY vcpu DESC

cases.q: Break down EOL-OS servers by environment.
cases.sql: SELECT env, COUNT(*) FROM servers WHERE os_eol_date < CAST(SYSUTCDATETIME() AS DATE) GROUP BY env ORDER BY env
